phrase.zh: 细分光的痕迹，靠的是更准的测量。
phrase.en: Finer traces of light require finer measures.

visual.zh: 斜置的黄铜色狭缝组件占据画面右侧，琥珀色晶体位于左下，弯曲的黑色胶片带上有两条银色纹。黑白版保留狭缝、晶体、胶片和裁切，金属刻纹更明显。这是精密测量的原创寓意，不是历史器材复原。
visual.en: An angled brass slit assembly dominates the right, with an amber crystal at lower left and two silver bands on a curving black film strip. Monochrome retains the slit, crystal, film and crop, with stronger metal hatching. This is an original precision metaphor, not a historical apparatus.

background.zh:
西格巴恩独享1924年诺贝尔物理学奖，奖项于1925年颁给他，理由是X射线光谱学领域的发现与研究。他改进X射线管、气泵与光谱测量装置，提高测量精度，帮助研究元素的特征X射线。金属狭缝、晶体与银色条纹是精密测量的原创寓意，不是历史器材复原，也不代表实际测量数据。短句为原创。
1924年物理学奖；独享本年度奖项。获奖理由（中文译述）：表彰他在X射线光谱学领域的发现与研究。
background.en:
Siegbahn received the full 1924 Nobel Prize in Physics in 1925 for discoveries and research in X-ray spectroscopy. He improved X-ray tubes, pumps and spectrographic instruments, increasing measurement precision and the study of characteristic X-rays from elements. The slit, crystal and silver bands are an original metaphor for precision, not a historical apparatus or measured data. The phrase is original.
1924 — The Nobel Prize in Physics. Received the full prize. Official motivation: for his discoveries and research in the field of X-ray spectroscopy
